title: 医学史学家林赛·菲茨哈里斯：瘟疫医生面具，竟是17世纪的“防护服”？
speaker: Lindsey Fitzharris

segments.en: And I love that they can be the heroes of their own story in the face maker. And looking at the skull, having read that book, one of the things that Gillies did that no one had really thought of before is figure out you can't just patch the skull on a face. It matters.
segments.zh: 我喜欢在《造脸师》中他们能成为自己故事的主角。看着头骨，读完那本书，吉利斯做了一件前人没想到的事：你不能只在脸上修补头骨，这很重要。

segments.en: The underlying, yeah, the skull of the jaw that all pulls in and he's spent a lot of time looking at it.
segments.zh: 底层的，对，下颌的头骨会牵拉，他花了很多时间研究它。

segments.en: Yeah, he worked with dentists. It was a real, you know, interdisciplinary approach to rebuilding the face. And honestly, I mean, if you think about it before
segments.zh: 是的，他与牙医合作。重建面部真正采用了跨学科方法。说实话，想想之前

segments.en: antibiotics, what he was able to do was astonishing. So that was, that was the world of the second book.
segments.zh: 抗生素时代之前，他能做到的事令人惊叹。那就是第二本书的世界。

segments.en: And then there was like some other objects I brought here that sort of just speak more generally to medical history. You have the plague doctor mask right there, which I think now, I know everybody
segments.zh: 然后我还带来了一些其他物品，更广泛地涉及医学史。那边有瘟疫医生面具，我想现在大家都知道

segments.en: knows what this is now, you know, it's the original mask. And I always call this the original hazmat outfit because the plague doctor would have not just been wearing the mask. He would have been wearing a full
segments.zh: 现在都知道这是什么了，这是原始面具。我一直称它为最早的防护服，因为瘟疫医生不仅戴面具，还会穿全套

segments.en: coat leather gloves. And this was in, in the beak was, was filled with sweet smelling, sweet smelling
segments.zh: 外套、皮手套。鸟嘴里塞满了芳香的

segments.en: herbs. And I always kind of trip over that because I've lived in Britain now for 24 years and they say herbs. And I'm always trying to think is it herbs, is it herbs? Anyway, sweet smelling like Zepa herbs.
segments.zh: 草药。我总在这词上卡住，我在英国住了24年，他们说herbs。我总在想是herbs还是herbs？总之是芳香的草药。

segments.en: And in the beak, and that was because they believe that something called myasma caused disease, that was like the bad smells. And so it would protect you from the bad smells. They would put the mask on.
segments.zh: 在鸟嘴里，因为他们相信一种叫瘴气的东西致病，就是难闻的气味。所以它能保护你免受恶臭。他们会戴上面具。

segments.en: People think it's medieval. Actually, it was invented in the 17th century. We don't know how much it was used because a lot of doctors, you know, they were pretty smart. They got out of town. They got
segments.zh: 人们以为这是中世纪的。其实它发明于17世纪。我们不知道它用了多少，因为很多医生很聪明，他们逃离了城镇。他们

segments.en: out of Dodge when the when the bubonic plague hit. But everybody kind of knows now having come out of a global pandemic, what the plague doctors mask was. And then that right there, if you want to pick that
